summary: Tested web Free test ring (GET/POST /api/cloudivr-web/numbers/:phone/test-call, TestRing card on the number Overview tab and on the order success page) and the one-tap bad-number cleanup (campaign notInService, POST /campaigns/:id/remove-bad-numbers, CampaignDetail BadNumbers banner, plus a code review of the bot bcclean: handler). Backend: 14/14 pytest pass. Dev suite test_improvements_iter225.js: 28/28 pass. Frontend: there was a CRITICAL regression. The checkpoint commit 89437ab9 removed the imports that RouteSummary still uses (useState, toast, Loader2, api, enc), so every number detail page crashed with 'ReferenceError: useState is not defined' and showed 'This screen ran into a problem'. I fixed it by putting the imports back. After the fix, all the frontend flows passed.

minor.issue: Nothing stops a second run. If the button is pressed again (for example from an older copy of the message), the bot replies 'Removed 0 not-in-service numbers' and sends the clean list again. It should say 'nothing to remove' when r.numbers is empty or badNumbersCleanedAt is already set.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: the imports for useState, toast, Loader2, api and enc were removed in this change, but the component still uses them. Every /cloudivr/app/numbers/:phone page crashed, so the TestRing card on the number page could not be reached at all.

design_issues.screen: Order success page, test-ring card (wide layout)
issues: When 'Another phone' is chosen, the number input and the 'Ring my phone' button sit on the same line with no gap between them. The input is inline and space-y-3 only adds vertical spacing, so the button also sits a little lower than the input. Put the button on its own line or wrap both in a flex gap-2 row.

'Download clean list' only shows right after the click. After a reload the banner says 'removed', but the user can no longer download the clean list. Consider letting them download it again, for example rebuilt from c.leads minus the not-in-service numbers.

action_items: Review the RouteSummary.js import fix (useState, toast, Loader2, api, enc put back). Then check the rest of the 89437ab9 diff for other removed imports. Run an undefined-variable check (eslint no-undef) on cloudivr pages before deploying.
Optional: stop bcclean from running twice, so a repeat press says 'nothing to remove'.
Optional: fix the spacing between the input and the button in the test ring card on the wide order success card.
Optional: let users download the clean list again after a reload.
critical_code_review_comments: TestRing.readyBrowser: the comment says 'Wait (≤8s)', but the function only starts rtc.connect and returns false right away. Nothing waits. The comment and the code disagree.
test-ring-note uses text-[#e4e4e7]. On the light theme it showed as dark text, so the theme seems to remap it, but the colour is meant for dark backgrounds. Confirm the contrast on both themes.

rca of the issue: RouteSummary crash: when TestNumber was moved out of RouteSummary.js (replaced by TestRing.js), the import lines were trimmed to 'React' plus Compass and AlertTriangle. RouteSummary itself still calls useState and setFwd (api, enc, toast) and renders Loader2. To reproduce, open any /cloudivr/app/numbers/:phone page: CrashGuard shows the error screen and the console logs 'ReferenceError: useState is not defined in <RouteSummary>'. Fix: put back the imports from react, sonner, lucide-react (Loader2) and ../../api (api, enc).
